court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Court No.3, Ghaziabad, Case No.1443 of 2021
case_name: Smt. Ayushi Jain vs Arpit Jain
facts_of_case: The applicant-wife sought transfer of a divorce case under the Hindu Marriage Act pending in the court of Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Court No.3, Ghaziabad to the court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Baghpat.

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a case from one judge to another.
legal_principles.held: In view of the consent given by the learned counsel for the opposite party, Case No.1443 of 2021 (Arpit Jain Vs. Smt. Ayushi Jain), under Section 13 (1) (ia) & 13 (1) (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act is transferred from the court of Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Court No.3, Ghaziabad to the court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Baghpat.

outcome.final_order: The record was remitted to the court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Baghpat for its disposal. No order as to costs.
